settings.heading: A wardrobe's worth of space, under the bed
settings.body:
Gas struts lift the whole base on one hand, and hold it there. Underneath is the full footprint of the bed — deep enough for a winter duvet, spare pillows, a suitcase and the Christmas decorations, all out of sight and off the floor.

It is the single best-value square metre in a British bedroom, and it costs about the same as the drawers it replaces.

settings.title: The frame
settings.text: Kiln-dried hardwood, corner-blocked and screwed rather than stapled. It is the part nobody sees, and the reason the bed does not creak in year three.

settings.title: The base
settings.text: Sprung slats on flexible beech, not a flat board. They take the load off the mattress and add years to it.

settings.title: The upholstery
settings.text: High-density foam over the frame, then fabric cut, pinned and hand-finished on the piece itself. Every seam is pulled true by hand.

settings.title: The finish
settings.text: Legs turned and stained to match, fixings bagged and labelled, and the whole bed checked over by the person who made it before it is wrapped.

settings.heading: Two weeks of work, and a bed that outlasts the room
settings.body:
A ComfortCrest bed is not flat-packed in a factory and shipped from a warehouse. It is cut, sprung, upholstered and finished by the same small team, in the same workshop, for one order at a time.

That is why we can guarantee the frame for ten years — and why we are happy to tell you exactly what is inside it.

settings.question: How long will my bed take to arrive?
settings.answer: Every bed is made to order, so allow around 14 working days from the day you order to the day it arrives. We call to book a delivery slot once your frame is finished, and give you a two-hour window the night before.

settings.question: Will you take it upstairs and build it?
settings.answer: Yes. Two people deliver every bed to the room of your choice, assemble it, and take all the packaging away with them. Please measure your stairs and doorways first — the size guide on this page lists the space each bed needs.

settings.question: Can I see the fabric before I commit?
settings.answer: Please do. We post up to six swatches first class, free, with no obligation. Colours read differently on a screen than they do on your wall, and this is the one part of the decision a photograph cannot make for you.

settings.question: What does the guarantee cover?
settings.answer: Ten years on the frame against manufacturing defects, and two years on moving parts such as ottoman gas struts. It covers the things we control — joints, timber and workmanship — rather than accidental damage or ordinary wear on the fabric.

settings.question: Will my existing mattress fit?
settings.answer: If it is a standard UK size, yes. Every ComfortCrest bed is built to the UK sizes listed above, so a UK Double mattress fits a UK Double frame. European and American sizes differ — measure yours before ordering.

settings.question: Can I change my mind?
settings.answer: Beds in our standard fabrics can be returned within 14 days of delivery under the Consumer Contracts Regulations. Because each bed is made to your order, please tell us as soon as you can — and note that a bed made in a bespoke fabric you supplied cannot be resold, so it is excluded.
